name: transaction-list
title: Transaction List
description: A short list of recent payments. Tapping a row morphs the whole card into a receipt for that purchase, carrying its icon, name and amount across before closing back to the list.
use: A finance app wants a compact payment history that opens into full receipt details on demand.
avoid: It is fixed to a narrow sixteen-rem column and the receipt offers no actions, so it is for viewing only.
a11y: Rows and the close control are click-only divs with no roles, focus or labels, so nothing here works from a keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card headed "Transaction" with four rows, each a small rounded icon, a merchant name over a category and an amount on the right. Expanded it becomes a receipt: icon and close button on top, merchant and amount, then dashed rules over id, date, time and card details.
behaves: Clicking a row grows the card into the receipt on a spring while the icon, name, category and amount slide to new positions. The close button collapses it back to the list, and the card's height animates to fit whichever view is shown.
customise: Only the transactions array is a prop, with icon, name, category, amount and extra receipt fields per item; the column width and spring are fixed.
weight: light: A few rows and one shared-layout morph, plus a height measurement.
